Definition: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); to shoot an arrow
BiblicalUsage: 1) to divide; 1a) (Qal) to divide; 1b) (Piel) to divide; 1c) (Pual) to be cut off, be finished; 2) to shoot arrows; 2a) (Piel) archer (participle)
